conclusion: For sufficiently general beta, every infinity point in the Sp4 orbit of d_y wedge(xz d_z-xw d_w) is removed by t-saturation.
limitations: Only the canonical xzw nonbinary orbit and its proved sixteen-dimensional exceptional strata.
Other nonbinary R0 normal forms z^2*w and z*w^2, their tails, flag and binary endpoints require separate analysis.
Not full infinity removal, affine finiteness, or component exhaustion.
